Why JTS GO

Everything you need, built in

No package installation. No configuration files. No build steps.

Instant HTTP Server

Spin up a web server with two lines of code. Add routes with http_route() — no frameworks required.

Machine Learning Ready

Live Demo

This page came from a JTS GO route

The server registers each path with http_route() and serves the files below.

srv = http_server(8080)
http_route(srv, "GET", "/",       read_file("public/index.html"))
http_route(srv, "GET", "/about",  read_file("public/about.html"))
http_route(srv, "GET", "/api/projects", read_file("data/projects.json"))
http_start(srv)
